text: This report recommends that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one (1) privately owned tree located at 28 Gaydon Avenue. The application indicates the reasons for removal are to address concerns that the tree is hazardous and too close to the residence. The subject tree is a linden tree (Tilia sp.), measuring 115 cm in diameter. The Private Tree By-law does not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.

Etobicoke York Community Council referred this Item back to the Director, Urban Forestry, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, having regard that City staff have re-assessed the health condition of the tree.
